newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volker Stevin wins major state road order.
newsitem.headline: Volker Stevin wins major state road order.

text.p: Construction firm Volker Stevin NV said on Wednesday it had won part of a major Dutch state infrastructural project order to re-develop the Hague suburb of Voorburg.

"The total project will be worth several hundred million guilders...and will mean a major improvement in our order portfolio in the coming years," Volker Stevin finance director Pim Dijkman told a news conference.
Dutch Transport Minister Anne-Marie Jorritsma was due to announce the commissioning of the project, involving a building development above a road, at a news conference at 1130 GMT in The Hague.
Volker Stevin declined to give any further details ahead of Jorritsma's briefing.
The company earlier announced first half net profits of 16.1 million guilders and an end-June order book of 2.1 billion guilders.
